source.note: WP-173 (research/15 G2): a merge request's general note listed as a discussion of its own, with resolvable: false. The discussion's shape (id, individual_note: true, one note with type null) is the individual-note entry of "List all merge request discussion items" on https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/; the note's resolvable: false is the value the notes page's "Retrieve a merge request note" example carries for a merge-request comment, and that example has no resolved member, so none is recorded. Adapted: merge request 34 of this corpus, one invented neutral comment by the corpus's reviewer account, fake ids and instants. Not a recording: the two pages contradict each other on resolvable, which is why merge request 35 records the other value.

source.note: WP-173 (research/15 G2): the individual-note entry of "List all merge request discussion items" as the page publishes it — individual_note: true, one note with type null, system false, resolvable: true and resolved: false. Adapted: merge request 35 of this corpus, one invented neutral comment by the corpus's reviewer account, fake ids and instants, and noteable_iid set where the page's example has null. The notes page shows resolvable: false for the same kind of comment (merge request 34 records that one).

WP-173 (research/15 G4): "Add note to a merge request thread" answers 201 Created with the created note, and the page says the endpoint "can also create a thread from a single comment". The page shows no response body, so the note is the note shape of the list example. Whether a live instance accepts an individual_note discussion's id here is [unverified] (docs/TODO.md § Verification); this interaction records the documented answer, and the adapter's fallback for a 400 or a 404 is held by provider.test.ts with scripted responses, not by this corpus.

source.note: WP-173: "Retrieve a merge request discussion item" after the reply — the thread the page says a reply creates from a single comment, so individual_note is false and it carries the general note and the platform's reply (its body opening with the <!-- agentic:… --> marker). Adapted: the page's discussion shape with this corpus's two notes. That individual_note turns false after a reply is inferred from "create a thread", not measured.

WP-173: since the reply endpoint's 404 is answered rather than thrown, the adapter reads the thread to tell "no such thread" from "an individual note it would not take"; this is that read for the unknown thread discussions.json's POST already answers 404 for, with the status table's 404 and the same message.
